actual_run.not_whole_suite: This is the independently observed bounded candidate run, not a substitute for the parent's final frozen aggregate/full suites.

mechanisms.name: ledger I/O uncertainty
mechanisms.faults: Exact ledger device/inode only. Partial append performs a real half write then ENOSPC; fsync and close perform their real operation then raise acknowledgement EIO; readback injects an early EOF after the real append.
mechanisms.assertions: No environment/provenance returned; persisted nonempty bytes are not truncated; owner metadata/directory remain; subsequent public reservation is locked and leaves bytes unchanged. Complete-record faults preserve ordinal 1.

mechanisms.name: late lock release acknowledgement failure
mechanisms.faults: Actual SourceLock release removes its own metadata/directory and syncs the parent; the scoped test then raises EIO from that sync acknowledgement.
mechanisms.assertions: No environment/provenance; actual ledger still contains ordinal 1; persistent namespace marker remains. The owner directory is already absent, so the next actual public reservation must enforce budget_exhausted:1/1 rather than refund the look.

mechanisms.name: same-bytes replacement owner
mechanisms.faults: After actual ledger append, rename the test's owner directory aside and create a different-inode directory with identical owner metadata bytes.
mechanisms.assertions: No environment/provenance; neither displaced owner nor replacement is deleted; replacement inode remains unchanged; subsequent reservation refuses and does not truncate the actual record.

mechanisms.name: partial legacy migration
mechanisms.faults: Create a real initial exposure, move its complete project ledger to the legacy results path, then inject a real half write/ENOSPC on the newly created project ledger only.
mechanisms.assertions: Legacy bytes remain exact; partial destination is preserved and never overwritten by the next public reservation; retained owner prevents blind retry. Migration failure is not an authorization to clear prior exposure history.

references.finding: Reader uses NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK, regular single-link validation, complete observed-length/EOF read and before/after/path identity matching.
Legacy project publication remains create-only; it does not replace an existing winner.

Reserve holds SourceLock; migration/append uncertainty is converted to SourceLockInDoubt inside the context, then to the public BenchmarkContractError outside. Fresh expected raw-prefix-plus-line, full records and owner checks precede return; context release must also succeed.

Exact owner identity gates nonrecursive release. SourceLockInDoubt retains the owner, while late release failure can occur after directory removal and must not be described as universal physical owner retention.
Generic locked_append performs rollback/truncation on failure and was correctly not reused for a nonrefundable exposure reservation.

limits: No new total-ledger byte cap; the history reader still allocates the complete observed history. Per-read bounded chunks are not a total-memory bound.
File observations and local fault injection do not prove an atomic snapshot of the whole project or cross-host exactly-once execution.
No automatic owner recovery or deletion/refund of uncertain exposure bytes was added.
The release test explicitly demonstrates why an absent owner directory after a late sync error is not an unused benchmark budget.
